content: अवसः [अव्-असच् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 117</ls>; अवतीत्यवसो राजा भानुश्च <ls>Ujjval.</ls>] .²1 A king. .²2 The Sun. .²3 A kind of tree (अर्क). .{@-सम्@} .²1 Refreshment, food, यदमुष्णीतमवसं पणिं गाः <ls>Rv. 1. 93. 4</ls>. provision (especially for a journey), {%viaticum%} (˚सः also); एतत्ते रुद्रावसम् <ls>Yv. 3. 61</ls>. .²2 Preserving, protecting.
